title: Hatsune Miku — Brand New Stage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
One, two, three, four...
And two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Got to make sure to stretch my legs properly...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Done! Now, I guess I'll start with strength training.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Push-ups, sit-ups, some back exercises, then squats.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! You're already starting back at school next week?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes! And we'll be in the credit-based course at last! I'm getting a little excited.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I wonder what my classmates will be like?
I hope I'm put in Haruka's class...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I'm going to be much more free to do idol work. Hehehe, I'm really looking forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (MORE MORE JUMP! are going to be more active than ever as idols...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I have to be on top of my game if I want to be in a position to support them.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright. Next up, sit-ups!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One... Two... Three... Four...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Phew...
That's three sets of everything.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now to—
Miku, do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry to interrupt your training.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The thing is, I accidentally made too much of this drink... I can't finish it all myself, so I came to give you some.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really? Well, if you don't mind.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't mind at all. It's still cold so I'm sure it'll be refreshing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You looked like you were really getting into your training just now, but maybe it'd be a good idea to take a break?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait, were you waiting for me to finish, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Only for a little while.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I was actually just going to leave the drink here so as not to disturb you, but—

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh no! Rehearsal's about to start! I need to get back to MEIKO and Rin ASAP!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh yeah, you're helping them prepare for their show, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. We're on the stage over there, so don't hesitate to come over if you need anything. See you later!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Got it! Thanks, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (He must have decided to call out to me since I wasn't stopping for a break.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When I train alone, I have a habit of getting too in-the-zone and forgetting to take breaks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let's try this drink then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Ahh, that hits the spot!
So refreshing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have my own show with Luka and Len to prepare for. Once I'm done resting, I need to get a move on with training.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, there you are, Miku♪
You were practicing here, I see.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's time for our group practice.
Are you finished with your solo training?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I think it's going to take a little bit more time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll be done as soon as I can. Hold on!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, may I join you in that case?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nice idea. I've been curious about your training routine, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But didn't you two just come from doing your own solo trainings? Aren't you tired?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Not at all♪
Unlike a certain someone, we don't forget to take breaks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Also, we're going to make sure that you take regular breaks while we practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, I will.
I was actually just thinking about how I always forget to take breaks.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Are Luka and Len worried for me too?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's thanks to everyone looking out for me like this that I'm able to do my best as an idol.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It would be nice to pay them back somehow...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'll think about what I can do after practice is over♪)
